steps.title: Bem-vindo: Listening - Volume 25
steps.text: In this B1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Listening". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: There's too much background noise to hear clearly.
She left me a voicemail this morning.
I had to rewind that part to understand it.

steps.title: Desafio de Tradução
steps.question: Qual é a tradução correta para "background noise"?

steps.title: Desafio de Compreensão Auditiva
steps.question: Ouça a frase com atenção e selecione a palavra correta pronunciada.
steps.audioText: She left me a voicemail this morning.

steps.title: Prática de Pronúncia
steps.text: Fale a seguinte frase em voz alta no microfone:
steps.targetPhrase: I had to rewind that part to understand it.

steps.title: Desafio de Escrita
steps.question: There's too much background noise to hear clearly.

steps.correctTranslation: Tem muito ruído de fundo para ouvir direito.

steps.title: Organize a Frase
steps.question: Ordene as palavras para formar a frase: "She left me a voicemail this morning."

steps.title: Gramática: Simple Past
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Simple Past"?
options: I visited my grandmother last week.
They have lived here for ten years.
He speaks as well as you do.
If it rains, I will stay home.

steps.title: Idiom: Bite the bullet
steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.
